diagnosis.hypothesis: Observed initial public validation failures only on paths involving user1 to web1 and app1, while other paths were healthy. Read topology and scoped configs, then confirmed leaf1 uplink ethernet-1/1.0 had IPv4 enabled but no address, despite the fabric using leaf1 next hop 10.255.0.1. Added 10.255.0.1/31 to leaf1 ethernet-1/1.0. Re-ran public success criteria and lab connectivity passed for all tested endpoint pairs.
diagnosis.reference: On leaf1, interface ethernet-1/1 lost its IPv4 address: 10.255.0.1/31 was removed, so the interface has no address on the fabric_l1_s1 segment.

arguments.name: ethernet-1/1.0
arguments.reason: leaf1 uplink ethernet-1/1.0 has IPv4 enabled but no address, while spines route 10.10.10.0/24 and 10.10.20.0/24 via leaf1 next hops 10.255.0.1 and 10.255.0.3; missing 10.255.0.1 breaks reachability to user1

action.command: set / interface ethernet-1/1 subinterface 0 ipv4 address 10.255.0.1/31
